title: REQ · Zero remaining quota shows an inline 'used all your suggestions' message
summary: Inline message appears only when remaining quota is 0
description: Context: the sheet shows 'Contributions left: N' only. Desired behavior: when remaining is 0 an inline alert reads 'You have used all your suggestions this round'. Expected result: the message is present at 0 and absent above 0. Why: the player needs a clear reason Send is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Given 5 sent entries from listMine, when the sheet opens, then 'You have used all your suggestions this round' is in the document
Given fewer than 5 sent entries, when the sheet opens, then that text is not in the document
technical_constraints: Message text must be exactly 'You have used all your suggestions this round'
definition_of_done: Message renders at remaining 0 and not above 0
